_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Acceptance Inspection Equipment Report
summary: The Acceptance Inspection Equipment Report provides comprehensive documentation of the required inspection test equipment used in final inspection of a product.
use_relationship:
The Report on Acceptance Inspection Equipment/Automated Acceptance Inspection Equipment (AIE/AAIE) will provide comprehensive documentation of the required inspection test equipment to be used in final inspection of a product.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of DODISS at the time of the solicitation; or, for non DODISS-listed documents, as stated herein.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall include a cover page specifying the following elements:

children.title: Contractor's company name and CAGE Code.
Document revision (first revision will be indicated with a "-").
Signature block with both typed and signature of submitter.
The Report shall contain a list of all inspection/testing equipment required by the technical data package to inspect all characteristics, including the following:
All inspection devices, including Government furnished, contractor designed, and commercially acquired.
Details of processes which are essential to achieving the engineering requirements of the item when these processes are not published or generally available to industry.
Proposed inspection equipment, gage and/or tool.
Accuracy and Resolution of equipment gage and/or tool.
Specific calibration information and how it complies with ANSI/NCSL Z540.3-2006 and ISO 10012-2003 shall be specified.

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall be in Microsoft Word/Excel, Version 2007-2010.
